things can be classified but not people.

Classifying or categorizing limits the person

God declares in OT, I am that I am.

Self existant one

I have owned a number of recording medium.

While it is tempting to label the recording, I often leave it blank.

It does take longer to find out

But the mystery of it.

When I hear the recording, I know which recording it is.
